_description: Record of one synthetic_data.py run, for benchmark reports. The script has no --config flag and does not read this file: pass each value as its CLI flag (output -> --output, shape -> --shape 1000,2048,2048, chunks -> --chunks, dimensions -> --dims time,frequency,baseline, compression_level -> --compression-level, overwrite: true -> --overwrite). This shape is 15.6 GiB of float32 (12.5 MiB chunks).
